materials.title: Asphalt 030
materials.authorAttribution: Official ambientCG attribution; the asset API does not name an individual photographer.
materials.transform: sRGB albedo converted to linear and normalized to a 0.5 multiplier mean with restrained grain contrast. All maps flipped for DataTexture and Lanczos downsampled. Height, roughness and AO packed into one RGB image. World-space sampling preserves the measured 2.2 metre tile; derivative fade filters the relief at distance.

materials.title: Corrugated Steel 009
materials.authorAttribution: The official license requests attribution to ambientCG; the asset API does not identify an individual photographer.
materials.transform: Convert sRGB albedo to linear, normalize to the existing vertex palette with highlight headroom, rotate the complete map set and tangent normal vectors 90 degrees, flip rows for DataTexture, Lanczos downsample. Preserve source aspect at a 2 x 4 metre repeat (15 ribs, approximately 13 cm apart).

materials.title: Plaster 007
materials.authorAttribution: The official license requests attribution to ambientCG; the asset API does not identify an individual photographer.
materials.transform: Convert sRGB albedo to linear, normalize to each existing family mean with highlight headroom, flip rows for DataTexture and Lanczos downsample. Real height, roughness, AO and OpenGL normal XY share the existing stochastic wall sampling; horizontal paving keeps its world-space aggregate.

generatedAssets.provenance: Original procedural timber, masonry and rock plus CC0 ambientCG CorrugatedSteel009 and Plaster007 scans. Per-source attribution, licenses and original file digests appear above.
generatedAssets.encoding: Gzip; nine RGB images then five R height images in source library order; PSCAN001 header then metal and plaster records, each five interleaved bytes per texel: roughness, AO, metalness, normal X, normal Y. Runtime packs the real scan response into height GBA and reconstructs normal Z.

generatedAssets.provenance: CC0 ambientCG Asphalt030 surface photogrammetry; original source archive and map digests above.
generatedAssets.encoding: Gzip; RSCAN001 header, RGB linear albedo image, RGB packed height/roughness/AO image. Expanded into two shared RGBA textures at runtime.
